basis.note: All saved places weighted equally. Provenance (might_try/must_try/hidden_gem/good_eats) is not a quality hierarchy and is not used here.

descriptiveOnly.note: Recorded for display, NOT scoring inputs. Rating is too tightly distributed to discriminate and weighting it would push down the low-rated favourites. Review count shows no obscurity preference. Price is missing for ~46% of saved places and ~75% of off-list candidates.
